units.source_text: “输给他们了……可要让我等到每天来送水的那时候可吃不消……

en.t: but I cannot stand waiting until the time they bring water every day...

units.source_text: 第一，这嗓子渴得冒烟可干不了活……

en.t: For one thing, my throat is so dry it feels like smoke is coming out, and I cannot work...

units.source_text: 想请你马上联络一下呀……你自己也口渴难挡吧？”

en.t: I want you to contact them right away...
you are unbearably thirsty yourself too, aren’t you?”
